diagnosis: Customer asks whether adding 4 seats next week incurs a full month charge. Reference KB-0011 which states seat additions are billed pro rata from the day they are added. No escalation required.
reply: When you add seats in the middle of a billing cycle, we bill them on a pro‑rated basis for the remaining days of that cycle. So the 4 new seats you add next week will be charged only for the portion of the month left, not for a full month. Any seat removals would take effect at the next renewal and would not generate a mid‑cycle credit.
